blocks.html:
AVERY DENNISON & 3M VINYL RECREATIONAL WRAP

When it comes to trying new things and pushing our boundaries, the Vinyl Wrap Toronto team is all about it. Nothing excites us more than doing something that encourages us to learn. It is one of our driving forces. When we’re between jobs, the designers and installers don’t just sit idle. We think of creative new ideas that we can suggest to our potential clients. So, we practice doing that in advance solely because no one wants to go get something wrapped from someone who does not have experience with that kind of object or vehicle.

So far over the years, Vinyl Wrap Toronto has dabbled its toes in various kinds of experimental recreational vinyl wraps. The vehicles and objects that people can’t generally get wrapped because there aren’t many wrap agencies that would get into something like that. We believe learning is an everlasting process, we learn by doing recreational wraps instead of experimenting on our customer’s vehicles.

Recreational vinyl wraps also allow us to experiment with new techniques, new materials, and designs. It helps us chisel our skills and makes sure our customers get quality service as a result of all the practice. We have experienced installers who only use Avery Dennison & 3M to wrap vehicles and objects, while also experimenting with the new materials available on the market in hopes of finding something better than Avery Dennison & 3M. We’ve wrapped golf carts, scooters, bicycles, laptops, etc. just because we wanted to sharpen our skill set and do something productive in our free time.

When you contact us you can be sure that you’re dealing with people who have been in the industry long enough, polishing their installation skills, to perfectly wrap your vehicle or object. The first team you’ll interact with is our team of highly professional and empathic graphic designers who are just waiting to talk to you, listen to your requirements with an open mind, and present you with a digital mockup that shows the design based on your input. When you approve the design, our installers take over and wrap your vehicle with your customized Vinyl Wrap. You can rest assured knowing your vehicle or object is in capable hands.

If you wish to give your vehicle or object a fresh new look, we’re here to make that happen with your favourite graphic. Feel free to call us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4 to have your queries answered and see our experts in action.
